# v0.1.25 preview

This artifact is a preview. It does not claim equivalence with other hosted
workflow services.

The version string is 0.1.25. The capability version is 12.

A `poll --place` object can include a `jobs` allow-list of configured job IDs.
New jobs and capacity-waiting jobs skip places that exclude them. A place
without the list remains unrestricted. Empty, duplicate, non-string, or
unconfigured entries fail startup with `INVALID_PARAMS`. One poller still
owns each repository.

A stale pull request merge ref is retried before a terminal trust error is
posted. A mismatch must persist across three consecutive passes on the same
head. A new head resets the count, and a matching merge ref clears the error.

A live submission retry requires the dedicated clone and refuses to clean a
different worker repository. A submission assigned to a named placement is
refused instead of retried on the local worker. Inspection marks only a
tested-commit mismatch as a stuck `STATUS_REFUSED` result.

An action path is passed as a path. A path segment that starts with a dash
is refused.

The wheel and the source tarball can be built from this tree. They are not
published. This change does not create a tag.

The project license is the MIT License.

No credentials are included in the artifact.
